cands.name: Nick DiCeglie
cands.bio: Republican state senator for SD 18 since Nov 2022; state representative (HD 66) 2018-2022. Born 1973, grew up in New York, moved to Florida in 1996; small business owner who worked in his family's sanitation business.
cands.local_ties: Moved to Florida in 1996; district covers part of Pinellas County. Residence city not stated in sources read.

record.text: HD 66 2018-2022 (beat Berny Jacques in the 2018 primary); SD 18 since 2022, succeeding Jeff Brandes.

controversies.text: Florida Phoenix (May 19, 2023) headline: business partners sue Sen. DiCeglie over alleged embezzled funds for his political career. Article body unreadable; outcome of the suit not verified.
